RESULT. SignedUnitFactorThetaComparison at the paper/source-selected arithmetic Haar is NOT asserted; it is reduced exactly to a named mu-free equation (the precise first missing), and that equation is proved sharp. Normalization part of S1916 is discharged; no arbitrary mu and no fake normalization.

1) Source Haar: paperArithmeticHaar places tuple mu := (mu (arithmeticTupleCanonicalUnitReference places tuple))^{-1} • mu. Proved additive Haar; proved paperArithmeticHaar unitReference = 1 (unit-region normalization, nothing about the hull used).
2) Source-Haar reduction: SignedUnitFactorThetaComparison ... (paperArithmeticHaar ...) C3 <-> SourceHaarHullThetaComparison := (arithmeticTupleHullUnitLogVolume places tuple = (c3ThetaSignedProcession C3).average). Corollary: the comparison is INDEPENDENT of the auxiliary additive Haar mu (sourceHaar_comparison_independent_of_initialHaar). Named: S1931FirstMissing; s1931_firstMissing_iff_comparison.
3) C6 canonical hull mass at the source Haar: (paperArithmeticHaar mu hull).toReal = Real.exp (arithmeticTupleHullUnitLogVolume ...); and for every a, source-Haar hull mass = ofReal(exp a) <-> hullLog = a. So the target is also exactly the C6 hull-mass equation hull mass = ofReal(exp signed average).
4) Hull side as norm-power (C6 analogue of S865): exists least scaling vector lam with arithmeticTupleHullUnitLogVolume = Real.log (distribHaarChar (product of E j) (scalingUnits lam)).
5) Theta side: sourceThetaWeightSum l := sum_j ((gaussExponent j.1).toNat : Real) > 0; logVolume = W * log q; signed average = - (log q * W)/card.
6) EXACT FIRST MISSING (s1931FirstMissing_logq):
   S1931FirstMissing <-> Real.log C3.thetaPacket.q = - (arithmeticTupleHullUnitLogVolume places tuple * card) / sourceThetaWeightSum l,
   card = #(SignedLabel l.value), W = sum_j j^2.
   I.e. the source q parameter is determined by the actual C6 arithmetic canonical-hull log index. This is a numeric comparison of two invariants, not a normalization.
7) Sharpness: exactly one packet parameter realizes it (existence + uniqueness), and since arithmeticTupleHullUnitLogVolume >= 0 it forces q <= 1, so the comparison FAILS for every theta packet with q > 1 (sourceHaar_comparison_false_of_one_lt_q). At the trivial packet q = 1 it holds iff mu hull = mu unitReference (sourceHaar_comparison_at_one_iff_hull_measure_eq).
8) Constructive direction for consumers: signedUnitFactor_of_sourceQ (target at the source Haar follows from the single explicit hypothesis log q = -(hull*card)/W) and paperArithmeticHaar_hull_mass_of_sourceQ. So the whole residual content is that one named arithmetic hypothesis.
9) S865 input quoted in log form (rootHaarFactor_log_norm_pow): log distribHaarChar(rootNormedExtension T b) lam = d * log ||lam||, from rootHaarFactor_normPow_actual via S861. Same shape as item 4; the two carriers (rootNormedExtension vs completion tensor) are NOT identified in tree — that carrier gap (S342) is the substance of the missing, not a normalization.

Why not proved: with the Haar normalization fixed by the source, the identity is exactly the q-value equation in 6), which is false for q > 1, so it cannot follow from the source normalization; proving it for the actual source C3 requires the paper's q/degree identification (not in tree).
